notice: Robots permission is necessary but not sufficient. Phase D.1 approves ONE host - the official Government Gazette file CDN congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn - for at most 10 instruments, at the exact individually listed URLs only, >=5s apart, one request at a time. All other hosts keep their prior decisions.

sources.permission_evidence: Official Cong bao (Government Gazette) file CDN of chinhphu.vn. robots.txt is absent (HTTP 404 => no published restriction; RFC 9309 2.3.1.3 "unavailable" means access is allowed). Files are linked directly from the official portal congbao.chinhphu.vn document pages whose own robots.txt is "User-agent: * / Allow: /". TLS certificate chain verifies against the system trust store; HTTPS only. Approval is limited to the exact official PDF URLs below and to <=10 instruments for Phase D.1.
sources.terms_review: Portal requires attribution ("Ghi ro nguon congbao.chinhphu.vn khi phat hanh lai"); recorded as an attribution obligation, not a bulk-download or re-licensing grant. No authentication, CAPTCHA or anti-bot control is circumvented; the CDN serves the public PDFs without challenge.
